verses.en: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.pt: O filho sábio ouve a instrução do pai; mas o escarnecedor não escuta a repreensão.
verses.en_web: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
verses.en_bbe: A wise son is a lover of teaching, but the ears of the haters of authority are shut to sharp words.

verses.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.pt: Do fruto da boca o homem come o bem; mas o apetite dos prevaricadores alimenta-se da violência.
verses.en_web: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things; but the unfaithful crave violence.
verses.en_bbe: A man will get good from the fruit of his lips, but the desire of the false is for violent acts.

verses.en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.pt: O que guarda a sua boca preserva a sua vida; mas o que muito abre os seus lábios traz sobre si a ruína.
verses.en_web: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps a watch on his mouth keeps his life; but he whose lips are open wide will have destruction.

verses.en: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.pt: O preguiçoso deseja, e coisa nenhuma alcança; mas o desejo do diligente será satisfeito.
verses.en_web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
verses.en_bbe: The hater of work does not get his desires, but the soul of the hard workers will be made fat.

verses.en: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.pt: O justo odeia a palavra mentirosa, mas o ímpio se faz odioso e se cobre de vergonha.
verses.en_web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man is a hater of false words: the evil-doer gets a bad name and is put to shame.

verses.en: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.pt: A justiça guarda ao que é reto no seu caminho; mas a perversidade transtorna o pecador.
verses.en_web: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
verses.en_bbe: Righteousness keeps safe him whose way is without error, but evil-doers are overturned by sin.

verses.en: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
verses.pt: Há quem se faça rico, não tendo coisa alguma; e quem se faça pobre, tendo grande riqueza.
verses.en_web: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
verses.en_bbe: A man may be acting as if he had wealth, but have nothing; another may seem poor, but have great wealth.

verses.en: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.pt: O resgate da vida do homem são as suas riquezas; mas o pobre não tem meio de se resgatar.
verses.en_web: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
verses.en_bbe: A man will give his wealth in exchange for his life; but the poor will not give ear to sharp words.

verses.en: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.pt: A luz dos justos alegra; porem a lâmpada dos impios se apagará.
verses.en_web: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
verses.en_bbe: There is a glad dawn for the upright man, but the light of the sinner will be put out.

verses.en: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.pt: Da soberba só provém a contenda; mas com os que se aconselham se acha a sabedoria.
verses.en_web: Pride only breeds quarrels, but with ones who take advice is wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: The only effect of pride is fighting; but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.

verses.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.pt: A riqueza adquirida às pressas diminuira; mas quem a ajunta pouco a pouco terá aumento.
verses.en_web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
verses.en_bbe: Wealth quickly got will become less; but he who gets a store by the work of his hands will have it increased.

verses.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.pt: A esperança adiada entristece o coração; mas o desejo cumprido é árvore devida.
verses.en_web: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
verses.en_bbe: Hope put off is a weariness to the heart; but when what is desired comes, it is a tree of life.

verses.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.pt: O que despreza a palavra traz sobre si a destruição; mas o que teme o mandamento será galardoado.
verses.en_web: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
verses.en_bbe: He who makes sport of the word will come to destruction, but the respecter of the law will be rewarded.

verses.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.pt: O ensino do sábio é uma fonte devida para desviar dos laços da morte.
verses.en_web: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
verses.en_bbe: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning men away from the nets of death.

verses.en: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.pt: O bom senso alcança favor; mas o caminho dos prevaricadores é aspero:
verses.en_web: Good understanding wins favor; but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
verses.en_bbe: Wise behaviour gets approval, but the way of the false is their destruction.

verses.en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
verses.pt: Em tudo o homem prudente procede com conhecimento; mas o tolo espraia a sua insensatez.
verses.en_web: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
verses.en_bbe: A sharp man does everything with knowledge, but a foolish man makes clear his foolish thoughts.

verses.en: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.pt: O mensageiro perverso faz cair no mal; mas o embaixador fiel traz saúde.
verses.en_web: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
verses.en_bbe: A man taking false news is a cause of trouble, but he who gives news rightly makes things well.

verses.en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.pt: Pobreza e afronta virão ao que rejeita a correção; mas o que guarda a repreensão será honrado.
verses.en_web: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
verses.en_bbe: Need and shame will be the fate of him who is uncontrolled by training; but he who takes note of teaching will be honoured.

verses.en: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.pt: O desejo que se cumpre deleita a alma; mas apartar-se do ma e abominação para os tolos.
verses.en_web: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
verses.en_bbe: To get one's desire is sweet to the soul, but to give up evil is disgusting to the foolish.

verses.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.pt: Quem anda com os sábios será sábio; mas o companheiro dos tolos sofre aflição.
verses.en_web: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
verses.en_bbe: Go with wise men and be wise: but he who keeps company with the foolish will be broken.

verses.en: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repaid.
verses.pt: O mal persegue os pecadores; mas os justos são galardoados com o bem.
verses.en_web: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Evil will overtake sinners, but the upright will be rewarded with good.

verses.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.pt: O homem de bem deixa uma herança aos filhos de seus filhos; a riqueza do pecador, porém, é reservada para o justo.
verses.en_web: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: The heritage of the good man is handed down to his children's children; and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the upright man.

verses.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.pt: Abundância de mantimento há, na lavoura do pobre; mas se perde por falta de juízo.
verses.en_web: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
verses.en_bbe: There is much food in the ploughed land of the poor; but it is taken away by wrongdoing.

verses.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.pt: Aquele que poupa a vara aborrece a seu filho; mas quem o ama, a seu tempo o castiga.
verses.en_web: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps back his rod is unkind to his son: the loving father gives punishment with care.

verses.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.pt: O justo come e fica satisfeito; mas o apetite dos ímpios nunca se satisfaz.
verses.en_web: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man has food to the full measure of his desire, but there will be no food for the stomach of evil-doers.
